title: Student portal worker saturation and 503 errors
symptoms: 503 errors, missed worker heartbeat, high request queue, memory pressure
resolution: Use restart_api for the controlled demo. Then verify error rate and latency return to normal.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion
symptoms: high pool utilization, waiting for connection, stale pooled connections, latency spike
resolution: Use rotate_connection_pool for the controlled demo. Verify pool utilization and request latency.

title: Stale application cache
symptoms: outdated content or stale reference data while service health remains normal
resolution: Use clear_cache only when stale-cache symptoms are present. Verify content freshness afterward.
